theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+1.21%) and Energy (+0.32%) led the market today, while Materials (-1.41%) and Utilities (-1.16%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +0.17% versus -0.67% for defensives and -0.50% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.02%, Dow -0.31%, Nasdaq +0.01% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.11%. The VIX rose 3.30% to 15.67, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.25% to $4,307.90, crude oil was little changed at $94.06, and bitcoin gained 0.06% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
